_note: Español de España; see topbar.json. The Bibles window (search, Install from File…, Done, each Bible's line), the sheet asking what a Bible file is, the Bible view's Options panel, installing, downloading and reading Bibles, and their errors and notices. Bible names, short names, references and Bible text are content and never translated; the window names each language in itself. lang-tables.js of the design has no rows for these; they follow its style.
